subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using the parts of sentences from each column of the table below : 1 5 =
stimulus: Culture badly influenced by the negative impacts of western culture. It very fond of showing hospitality. be Hospitality a term used for a way of life. represent We a society's beliefs, customs, languages, foods, etc. But nowadays our culture a part of Bangladeshi culture.
guide_solution: (a) Culture is a term used for a way of life. (b) It represents a society's beliefs, customs, languages, foods, etc. (c) Hospitality is a part of Bangladeshi culture. (d) We are very fond of showing hospitality. (e) But nowadays our culture is badly influenced by the negative impacts of western culture.
